title: Staged onboard manifest validator and autodraft changelog
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Add a staged onboard manifest validator that runs dry-run checks and emits an autodraft changelog for curator review. No runtime behavior changes; opt-in via onboarding pipeline flag.
description:
Motivation: onboarding new model artifacts has become noisy and error-prone: missing fields, invisible semver deltas, and manual changelog assembly cause regressions during releases. This PR introduces a staged validator that runs as part of the onboarding pipeline in 'dry' mode, validates against the v2 model manifest schema, computes a delta/impact summary and emits an autodraft changelog (curation hints + suggested release blurb) for the release assembler. The aim is to move more of the initial curation work into an automated, reviewable artifact so PM/curators can approve or refine before a release.

What this PR does (single-continuous description): adds a manifest validator binary (cmd/onboard/manifest-validate) with a --staged flag; implements schema v2 checks and soft-deprecation warnings; computes a prioritized delta score based on changes to tokenization, dims, quantization profile, and latency baselines; emits ./autodrafts/<model>-<version>-draft.md containing: a concise delta summary, suggested release blurb, risk tags (backcompat, perf-change, config), and curator hints. Adds an integrations hook that posts the autodraft to Linear when configured. Introduces a signed-draft mechanism (deterministic HMAC over manifest+delta) to support a rollback-guard: the release-assembler will refuse to auto-apply a draft that lacks a matching signature or whose hash doesn't match the staged manifest.

Checklist (what I did):
- add manifest schema v2 and compatibility layer (pkg/registry/schema_v2.go)
- staged validator binary and library (cmd/onboard/validator.go, pkg/onboard/validate.go)
- autodraft generator (tools/changelog/autodraft.go)
- deterministic HMAC signer + verification (pkg/onboard/signer.go)
- unit tests for schema compatibility, delta scoring, and HMAC (tests/unit)
- e2e: simulated onboarding flow writes autodraft to tmp and posts a Linear stub if API token present (tests/e2e)

Small illustrative snippets included inline in the diff: the autodraft template includes a deterministic header:
---
Draft-Source: staged-validator
Draft-Signature: HMAC:v1:<hex>
Model: example-llama-30b
Version: 2026-02-18
Delta-Summary: tokenization change (+1 token on prefix), quantization->q4_0 (latency +7%), backend-affinity change
Risk-Tags: perf-change, backcompat
Suggested-Blurb: "Updated tokenizer and quantization profile for throughput improvements; expect minor latency regressions at 512+ tokens."
---

Testing/CI notes: initial run surfaced a flaky e2e that depended on an external Linear test token; CI was rerun with a local stub and all checks passed. Summary: build (pass), unit (pass), integration (pass), e2e (pass after retry). Static linting flagged an exported function comment; fixed in a follow-up commit.

Review conversation (abridged, chronological):
- Kofi Mensah (review): "Nice approach — can we ensure schema_v2 validators are strictly additive and include a migration suggestion if a field is dropped? Also: please add an explicit performance budget test so the delta scorer can't regress the CI baseline."
- Author (Ava): "Added compatibility shim and a migration hint generator; added perf-budget test that asserts the delta score stays within expected bounds for known fixtures."
- Rina Patel (review): "Autodraft looks useful, but curious how curators will triage false positives — can the risk-tags be tuned per-team?"
- Author: "Yes — risk-tag thresholds are configurable via onboarding config (onboard.yaml). Documented in onboarding/README.md."
- Diego Alvarez (review): "Minor: move light-weight signer into pkg/onboard/internal to avoid accidental exported usage."
- Author: "Moved signer and added tests for verification failure modes."
- Kofi: "Approved after tests are green."
- Rina: "Approved, left minor doc nit; merging once CI passes."

Merge outcome: merged via squash on 2026-02-23 by Ava Martinez. Commit message summarized as: "staged onboard validator + autodraft changelog generator; add schema v2 and HMAC signed drafts; opt-in via onboarding flag".

Rollout/Migration notes: this change is opt-in. To enable: set onboarding.pipeline.staged_validate: true in onboarding config; provide linear.api_token if you want autodrafts to be posted automatically. No changes to runtime serving. Curators should review autodrafts in ./autodrafts or the Linear draft card and approve before release-assembler picks them up.

Follow-ups tracked: ENG-1560 (auto-apply approved drafts during canary releases), ENG-1579 (dashboard for autodraft acceptance rates), SUP-3121 pull-through for customer-facing migration notes.

If you want to exercise the new flow locally: make a small manifest change and run: ./bin/manifest-validate --staged --manifest ./example/manifest.json --out ./autodrafts/

End of description.
notes: Opt-in feature; no runtime dependency changes
Autodrafts are deterministic and signed to support rollback-guard
Linear posting is optional and controlled by API token in config
